original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克：前游击队员誓言确保抵运党代表大会如期举行
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 莫桑比克反对党抵运党（Renamo）的前游击队员于周一指控党领导人奥苏福·马马德（Ossufo Momade）采取拖延策略，意图破坏该党稳定，并誓言持续施压，以确保定于2027年下半年举行的党代表大会如期召开。该团体还批评全国委员会开除资深领导人安东尼奥·穆尚加（António Muchanga）的决定。上述指控来自该团体单方面说法，目前仅有一个来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 抵运党前游击队员指控党领导人奥苏福·马马德采取拖延策略破坏该党稳定
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Former guerrilla fighters from Mozambique’s opposition Renamo Party on Monday accused the party leader, Ossufo Momade, of resorting to delaying tactics to destabilise the party

key_facts.fact: 该团体誓言持续施压，确保定于2027年下半年举行的党代表大会如期召开
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: vowing to keep up the pressure to ensure that the congress, scheduled for the second half of 2027, goes ahead

key_facts.fact: 抵运党全国委员会于10月22日至23日举行第三次会议，将下届党代表大会定于2027年下半年
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The statements follow the third session of Renamo’s National Council, held on 22 and 23 October, which scheduled the party’s next congress for the second half of 2027

key_facts.fact: 该团体批评全国委员会开除资深领导人安东尼奥·穆尚加的决定
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The group also criticised the expulsion of veteran leader António Muchanga, decided by the National Council as part of disciplinary proceedings over alleged violations of Renamo’s statutes

key_facts.fact: 马马德在2024年大选中获得6%的选票，为该党支持候选人的最差成绩
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ossufo Momade, the presidential candidate backed by Renamo in the 2024 general elections, obtained 6% of the vote, the worst-ever result for a candidate supported by the party

uncertainties: 关于马马德采取拖延策略的指控来自前游击队员团体单方面说法，尚未获独立证实
党代表大会能否如期举行尚不确定
目前仅有一个来源（Club of Mozambique，引述Lusa）报道，缺乏交叉验证
